_comment: Component 3 of the Gold Set. Every item that caused a real error in v4..v10, each carrying the generation that broke it and the generation that fixed it, so a regression is identifiable by name rather than by a count moving. `must_not` is the assertion that actually matters: these lines are here because of where they WENT, not only because of where they should go.

items.must_not_reason: irrigation head sold as a fire sprinkler — the inversion that sent an RFQ for landscape parts to a fire-protection contractor
items.closure_note: v5 fixed the resolution; the guard was still bypassable through the lexicon path until v7 routed it through bestHit

items.note: the other half of the inversion: the Arabic fire sprinkler did not reach a specific intent at all

items.must_not_reason: reinforcement steel resolving as ready-mix concrete — a batching plant cannot supply rebar
the fibreglass tank reaching a concrete-admixture supplier, because «ألياف زجاجية» is also glass fibre for concrete
items.note: closed in v10 by removing the «زجاج» -> «ألياف زجاجية» suffix reach; verified on this line, not on the term list

items.en: flexible conduit for electrical cable runs
items.must_not_reason: conduit resolving as cable — the error that became MORE confident at A@0.90 in v5 before the attribute-clause rule
items.note: «لتمديد الكابلات» is an attribute clause describing the conduit, not naming a cable

items.must_not_reason: a door access-control system resolving as a turnstile — different product, different supplier
«عزل» in the breaker guard's block_any collides with insulation vocabulary, demoting a legitimate double-insulated breaker
items.note: OPEN as of v10. Recommended fix recorded in the v8 adjudication: replace the sloppy «عزل» with an isolator-specific term.

items.en: wood door (nisba form) — must resolve identically to ERR-08

items.note: closed by removing the adjacency requirement between «بلوك» and «مفرغ», so any adjective or misspelling between them is tolerated — rather than by adding «اسمني» to the vocabulary

items.en: hollow cement block, correct spelling — must resolve identically to ERR-10
electrical distribution boards, sound feminine plural — must resolve identically to ERR-12
items.note: the plural was unreachable before v10 unless hand-listed; «لوح» sheet and «لوحة» board were two collisions pointing at each other

items.must_not_reason: «معدني» read as METAL when it means MINERAL — a within-family-department error no cross-trade sweep can see
items.current_behaviour: resolves to NOTHING rather than wrongly — safe, but the correct answer is unreachable because mineral wool's Arabic name is not in thermal_insulation's vocabulary
items.note: This entry stays OPEN until the vocabulary gap is filled. Scoring it as a pass because it stopped being wrong would let a fallback masquerade as a fix.

items.must_not_reason: the metal ceiling tile going to a mineral-wool distributor instead of a metal former — the mirror image of ERR-14

items.note: never shipped broken: the derivation gate refused «زجاج» -> «زجاجي» and cost this line its family, moving booklet confident-wrong to 1.47%. Kept in the set because it is the regression the phrase exemption exists to prevent, and because a sector+position signal reaches it without the exemption.

items.must_not_reason: glass wool being claimed by a glazier because both are «زجاج»
